evidence.raw_text: Auditee: Information Security Manager. Position: ISMS Manager. Interview Notes: The organization has not defined consistent information-security risk assessment criteria. Each department currently uses its own informal method.

Checklist Item: Repeatable information-security risk assessment process established? Result: NON-COMPLIANT. Notes: No documented likelihood scale, impact scale, risk acceptance criteria, or common assessment method was available.

Document Name: Information Security Risk Register. Reference: RISK-REG-02. Review Notes: The register contained asset names and free-text concerns but did not record risk owners, likelihood, consequences, risk levels, or evaluation against acceptance criteria. The same gap affected all sampled business functions.
